```plato
    // The pose stored in a rigid affine matrix. Precondition: the matrix is a
    // rotation followed by a translation (no scale, shear, or reflection).
    Pose2D(m: Matrix3x2): Pose2D
        => (Point2D(m.Row3.X, m.Row3.Y), Rotation2D(m.Row1.Y.Atan2(m.Row1.X)));
```

## Line 1035

```plato

    //==
    // Rigid conversions — the Pose obligations of `IRigid2D` / `IRigid3D`. Each
    // rigid representation names the pose it is: a translation is a pose with
    // the identity rotation, a rotation is a pose at the origin, a
    // rotation-about-a-centre is the conjugation of the two. Composition and
    // inversion of any two rigid transforms stay inside the family, which is
    // what the interface buys over IAffine2D/IAffine3D.

    // A translation is the pose at that offset with no rotation.
    Pose2D(t: Translation2D): Pose2D
        => (t.Vector.ToPoint, Rotation2D.Identity);
```

## Line 1064

```plato

    // Rotating about a centre: translate the centre to the origin, rotate,
    // translate back.
    Pose2D(r: RotationAbout2D): Pose2D {
        var c = r.Center.PositionVector;
        return ((c - c.Transform(r.Rotation)).ToPoint, r.Rotation);
    }
```
